rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a self-contained part of a larger object or device.

example.english: This computer has a component that has broken.
example.traditional: 呢部電腦有個部件壞咗。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 jau5 go3 bou6 gin6 waai6 zo2

rows.note: Use this for an individual mechanical or machine part, especially one that can be replaced.

example.english: This bike needs a replacement component.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 daan1 ce1 jiu3 wun6 go3 ling4 gin6

rows.note: Use this for a module or assembled unit that forms part of a larger system or device.

example.english: This component can be plugged directly into the main unit.
example.traditional: 呢個組件可以直接插入主機。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zou2 gin6 ho2 ji5 zik6 zip3 caap3 jap6 zyu2 gei1

rows.note: Use this mainly for an electronic or technical component such as a resistor or circuit element.

example.english: Each component on this circuit board is neatly arranged.
example.traditional: 呢塊電路板上面嘅每個元件都排列得好整齊。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 din6 lou6 baan2 soeng6 min6 ge3 mui5 go3 jyun4 gin6 dou1 paai4 lit6 dak1 hou2 zing2 cai4
